describe: The image shows a character texture sheet for a soldier model: a full body in the centre, with a face at bottom left and separate pieces around it, such as arm strips at the sides and a torso panel. Every piece must stay exactly in place. The clothing is very dark, near-black, with muddy olive-green grey patches in the background and a tan-grey face. Lighting is dim with strong dark shadows across the body and faint warm yellow highlights on the hands and chest buckle.
